description: EffectSummary (src/compiler2/artifact.rs: allocates, observable, halts, calls_opaque) is read in production only by the backend dump (effects_text in canon.rs) and a derived equality check. About 190 test sites (pull_test.rs, ownership_test.rs, mutation_test.rs, drive_test.rs and others) use the ExecutableEffects product as their test vehicle, which is what keeps it alive. Choose a product the tests can use that production also needs, move the tests to it, delete EffectSummary, the effects fields, effects_text and the product. Moved out of fz-sc8.197 with the user's approval (2026-11-14); must close before the epic does. Coordinate with fz-engine: fz-t93.7 rewrites artifact scheduling and the pull system these tests exercise.
title: EffectSummary and the ExecutableEffects product are deleted; the pull tests get another vehicle
